approval_reference: Owner authorizes preparation of the Google Drive backup option, exact private destination/file review before any upload, and the smallest explicitly versioned change needed from local-only setup. Separate local cloud-v2 preparation, encrypted complete DB/custody/journal snapshots, fresh authenticated cloud read-back and isolated non-operational recovery. No upload authorization, collection, acceptance, inference, publication, deployment, merge or financial authority. Preserve local v1, all originals, model/scientific/wagering contracts, protected files/tests, prior baselines and policies. Owner authorizes draft-PR and required CI delivery followed by protected local setup. A reproduced unchanged-main synthetic-clock fixture defect is corrected only in test setup; all original assertions and application clocks remain unchanged. Shallow-checkout scope tests retain exact base identities without external fetches. Private evidence/Drive identities remain local.
